$comment: AI readiness benchmark: requirements as an app developer would write them, without the component's name where possible. `expect` lists the component ids that are a correct answer (the first is the best one). `tags`: the agent run passes when the code uses at least one of them; `attributes`: attributes (or slots, written `slot:<name>`) the code must also use. Add a task whenever an agent picked the wrong component in real use.

Ask the user to confirm before deleting a project, with a red destructive button
A small 'Are you sure?' popup anchored next to the archive button
